overview.p1: Welcome to Laku Marketplace! Our community rules ensure a safe, respectful, and productive environment for all users.
overview.p2: These guidelines apply to all interactions on our platform, including product listings, reviews, messages, and community discussions.
overview.p3: By using Laku, you agree to follow these community standards and help us maintain a positive marketplace experience for everyone.
overview.p4: Violations of these rules may result in warnings, content removal, account restrictions, or permanent suspension.

respect.title: Be Respectful & Professional
respect.body:
• Treat all users with respect and courtesy
• Use polite language in all communications
• Provide helpful and constructive feedback
• Be patient and understanding with other users

accurate.title: Provide Accurate Information
accurate.body:
• List products with honest descriptions
• Use clear, high-quality product photos
• Provide accurate pricing and availability
• Update product information regularly

quality.title: Maintain Quality Standards
quality.body:
• Ensure products meet safety standards
• Package items securely for shipping
• Provide excellent customer service
• Honor return and refund policies

report.title: Report Issues Responsibly
report.body:
• Report suspicious or inappropriate behavior
• Flag counterfeit or illegal products
• Contact support for technical issues
• Help maintain platform integrity

prohibited.title: Prohibited Content & Behavior
prohibited.body:
• No harassment, bullying, or hate speech
• No spam, scams, or fraudulent activities
• No counterfeit or illegal products
• No inappropriate or offensive content

misleading.title: Misleading Practices
misleading.body:
• Don't use fake reviews or ratings
• Don't manipulate search results
• Don't create duplicate accounts
• Don't misrepresent product quality

privacy.title: Privacy & Security Violations
privacy.body:
• Don't share personal information publicly
• Don't attempt to hack or exploit the platform
• Don't use unauthorized payment methods
• Don't violate intellectual property rights

abuse.title: Platform Abuse
abuse.body:
• Don't circumvent platform policies
• Don't use automated tools without permission
• Don't engage in price manipulation
• Don't interfere with other users' transactions

summary.title: 📋 Summary
summary.coreBody: Laku Marketplace is built on trust, respect, and mutual benefit. We expect all users to contribute positively to our community.
summary.takeaways:
• Be honest, respectful, and professional in all interactions
• Provide accurate product information and quality service
• Report violations and help maintain platform integrity
• Respect others' privacy and intellectual property
• Follow all applicable laws and regulations
summary.enforcementBody: Violations are reviewed on a case-by-case basis. We may issue warnings, remove content, restrict accounts, or suspend users who repeatedly violate these rules.
summary.questionsBody: If you have questions about these rules or need to report a violation, please contact our support team through the Help Center.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Laku collects, uses, discloses, and protects your personal information when you use our marketplace applications and services.

sections.collectBody:
• Account Data: name, phone number, country/region, email, profile details.
• Authentication Data: verification codes (WhatsApp/SMS), device identifiers for fraud prevention.
• Transaction Data: orders, payments, refunds, vouchers, wallet balance (LakuPay), discounts and bonuses.
• Usage Data: pages viewed, buttons clicked, device and app version, approximate location (country/region).
• Communications: messages with support and notifications preferences.
sections.useBody:
• Provide and improve core features including account creation, order processing, and wallet management.
• Authenticate your identity, send verification codes, and protect against fraud and abuse.
• Personalize your experience (e.g., recently viewed, buy again) aligned with Laku standards.
• Communicate with you about orders, promotions, and service updates.
• Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms.
sections.shareBody:
• Service Providers: payment processing, analytics, cloud hosting, and communications strictly under contract.
• Business Partners: where you opt in to specific services, we may share minimal data to fulfil your requests.
• Legal Requirements: to comply with applicable laws, regulations, or lawful requests.
• Transfers: in a merger, acquisition, or asset sale, we will notify you where legally required.
sections.retentionBody: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to provide services, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Retention periods vary by data type and regulatory requirements.
sections.rightsBody: Subject to local laws, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, or portability of your data. You can also object to certain processing or withdraw consent.
sections.securityBody: We use industry-standard safeguards including encryption in transit, secure credential storage, risk-based authentication, and access controls. While no system is perfectly secure, we continuously improve our protections.
sections.childrenBody: Laku is not directed to children under the age of 13 (or the minimum age in your jurisdiction). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
sections.changesBody: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices or legal requirements. We will post updates in-app and revise the effective date.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.intro: These Terms govern your access to and use of Laku marketplace applications and services. By using our services, you agree to these Terms.

sections.accountsBody: • You must provide accurate, current information. You are responsible for maintaining account security.\n• Social sign-in (e.g., Google) must map to your valid email. We may require additional verification.
sections.ordersBody: • Prices, promotions, and stock availability may change.\n• Payments may be processed by third-party providers. Refunds follow product and channel rules.\n• Disputes and chargebacks will be reviewed according to policy and evidence provided.
sections.walletBody: • LakuPay balances, bonuses, and discounts are subject to eligibility and expiry rules.\n• Misuse, fraud, or policy violations may result in suspension or forfeiture as permitted by law.
sections.useBody: You agree not to: violate laws; infringe IP; reverse engineer; spam; harm users; or interfere with the service. We may suspend accounts involved in prohibited activities.
sections.ipBody: Laku trademarks, logos, and content are protected by law. You may not use our branding without prior written permission.
sections.liabilityBody: To the extent permitted by law, Laku is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages. Our aggregate liability is limited to amounts you paid within the last 6 months.
sections.terminationBody: We may suspend or terminate your access for policy violations, unlawful activity, or risk to users. You may stop using the services at any time.
sections.lawBody: These Terms are governed by applicable local laws where Laku operates or as required by mandatory consumer protection laws.

cards.basicsBody: You can request a return for eligible items and get a refund after the request is approved and, when required, the items are received back in good condition.
cards.policyBody1: Each product has its own return policy stored in the product data. It defines whether it is returnable, how many days after delivery you can request a return, and any specific conditions.
cards.policyBody2: Laku checks every return/refund request against this policy. Different items in the same order can therefore have different eligibility and refund amounts.
cards.policyStrong: Refund approval and amount always depend on the return days and rules saved on each product, not only on the order status.

steps.1: Check the product's return policy and time limit before buying a product.
steps.2: Returns and refunds are only available when products have been delivered and received.
steps.3: Start a return/refund request from order details.
steps.4: Follow any instructions to send back the item with strong proof and evidence of return request.
steps.5: Wait for review and refund to your payment method or wallet.

orderHelpCenter.title: Order Help Center
orderHelpCenter.overviewBody: This page gives a short guide for tracking your order and knowing who to contact. Any actions such as cancel, rate, or request return/refund are done in the main order details screen.

sections.deliveryStatusBody: Open the order details page to see the latest status, delivery partner, tracking number, and any delivery notes for this order.
sections.statusBasicsNote: Some options (like rate order or request return/refund) only appear after certain statuses for buyer and seller protection.
sections.contactSellerBody: Use "Contact seller" from the order details when delivery looks late, product details are unclear, or the parcel you receive does not match the order.
sections.contactSupportBody: Contact Laku support through the main Help Center if you cannot reach the seller, see a payment or refund issue, your status is stuck for too long, or you suspect fraud or policy abuse.
